definitions.explanation: Making something better, often through continuous small changes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改善|かいぜん}⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to improve my lifestyle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{改善|かいぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{改善|かいぜん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{改善|かいぜん} means improvement, especially through deliberate effort. It is also famous worldwide as a Japanese business philosophy ("kaizen") emphasizing continuous, incremental improvement.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Both transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) and intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- Transitive: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改善|かいぜん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧
- Intransitive: [noun]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{改善|かいぜん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改善|かいぜん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to improve ~
- {改善|かいぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{余地|よち}→余地：07612_yochi⟧: room for improvement
- {改善|かいぜん}⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: points to improve
- {改善|かいぜん}⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧: improvement measures
- {改善|かいぜん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧: improvement is observed

USAGE:
Applies broadly: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{改善|かいぜん} (health improvement), ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧{改善|かいぜん} (environmental improvement), ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧{改善|かいぜん} (work process improvement).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {改善|かいぜん}: general improvement (of conditions, situations)
- ⟦{改良|かいりょう}→改良：09681_kairyou⟧: improvement of products, systems, or methods
- ⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧: enhancement, raising to a higher level (⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧ = skill improvement)

ASPECT (ている):
- Intransitive: ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{改善|かいぜん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: the situation is improving / has improved (state of ongoing or completed improvement)
- Transitive: [person]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧[X]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改善|かいぜん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: is working on improving X (progressive action)
- {改善|かいぜん}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧: has been improved (passive resultative — commonly used for systems, products, conditions)
- Note: Because {改善|かいぜん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is both transitive and intransitive, the ている form has different meanings. With the intransitive (subject が), it commonly indicates the resulting improved state or a gradual improvement trend. With the transitive (subject が, object を), it describes the ongoing activity of making improvements.
